scientific_question: What is the most defensible physical/catalog nature of the frozen source groups nearest the EDEM and LOVE coordinates, using catalog morphology, photometric quality, counterpart structure, and Gaia astrometry without anomaly scoring?

requires: AllWISE source exists at frozen identifier
W1 SNR is finite and positive
WISE_CLEAN_POINTLIKE_CATALOG_DETECTION.meaning: No catalog-level evidence of a flagged image artifact, resolved/known-extended association, or active blend in the AllWISE summary fields. This does not prove the source is astrophysical or identify its class.

requires: no Gaia/SDSS/Pan-STARRS/2MASS member joins the AllWISE detection under frozen tolerances
WISE_ONLY_NO_FROZEN_COUNTERPART.meaning: The source remains IR-only under the current catalog depths and match radii. This is compatible with a faint ordinary IR source, unresolved distant galaxy, or an object below optical/NIR catalog limits; those alternatives require deeper data.

requires: a Pan-STARRS positional counterpart exists within 1 arcsec
SDSS_GALAXY_MORPHOLOGY_SUPPORTED.meaning: SDSS imaging morphology supports an extended/galaxy interpretation for the optical group. This is a morphology classification, not a spectroscopic redshift or semantic EDEM identity.

requires: cross-survey members join under frozen tolerances
GAIA_STELLAR_ASTROMETRIC_GROUP.meaning: A Gaia-linked astrometric source group is consistent with a stellar/point-source interpretation. Reliable distance inference additionally requires the preregistered parallax-SNR rule.

required_outputs: SDSS morphology for the 13.31 arcsec optical group
Gaia astrometric context for control groups
pairwise separation between EDEM WISE-nearest and optical-nearest groups
conservative physical classification label with explicit uncertainty

firewall.claim_ceiling: Catalog-based physical source characterization only. No anomaly, artificial object, EDEM identity, planet, or new-physics claim.

reference_notes.allwise: IRSA AllWISE Explanatory Supplement: cc_flags reports artifact contamination/confusion; ext_flg reports extended/confused/2MASS-XSC association; nb/na describe blend/deblend context.
reference_notes.sdss: SDSS PhotoObj type=3 is galaxy morphology and type=6 is star morphology.
reference_notes.panstarrs: Pan-STARRS provides independent optical positions; detailed star/galaxy separation may later use PSF-Kron or PS1-PSC, but this v1 does not tune a new morphology threshold after seeing the field.
